title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, create a single circle as the first loop. Place the center of this circle at coordinates [0.0149, 0.0149] and set the radius to 0.0149 units. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.0298 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the same Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it with the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. To generate the three-dimensional model, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will result in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of 0.029812500000000002 units, a width of 0.029812500000000002 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circle
center = (0.0149, 0.0149)
radius = 0.0149

# Create a circle in the XY plane
r = r.center(*center).circle(radius)

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0149, 0.0149)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0149)  # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# The part is a cylindrical rod: circular top view, long vertical front/right views
# Diameter = 0.0298 (X and Y bounding box), Length = 0.75 (Z bounding box)

diameter = 0.0298
length = 0.75

# Create a cylinder centered at origin along Z
r = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(diameter / 2).extrude(length / 2, both=True)
